info.title: GKit.Cli
info.description: Command line companion to the GKit suite: scaffolds solutions from GKit.Templates and handles the lifecycle work dotnet new cannot express - swapping package and project references, aligning versions, diagnosing drift and running the UI migration codemod.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Command line companion to the GKit suite.

arguments.name: TEMPLATE
arguments.description: One of: sln, app, shared, data, migrator, worker, test

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description: Name of the solution or project

arguments.name: OPTIONS
arguments.description: Options forwarded to dotnet new, e.g. --ui radzen --db npgsql --features quartz,reporting

commands.name: add
commands.description: Wire a capability into an existing solution, or scaffold an item.

arguments.name: WHAT
arguments.description: A capability from features.json, or one of: job, clirunner, crud

arguments.name: OPTIONS
arguments.description: Options forwarded to dotnet new for item templates.

commands.name: link
commands.description: Swap GKit package references for project references into a local checkout.

options.name: --path
options.description: Local GKit checkout. Auto-detected when omitted.

options.name: --only
options.description: Comma separated package ids to link. Defaults to all GKit packages.

options.name: --no-solution
options.description: Do not add or remove the linked projects in the solution file. [default: False]

commands.name: unlink
commands.description: Restore the package references replaced by 'gkit link'.

options.name: --no-solution
options.description: Do not add or remove the linked projects in the solution file. [default: False]

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Report drift, retired packages and other rot in the solution.

commands.name: update
commands.description: Align every GKit package version in the solution.

options.name: --to
options.description: Version to align on. Defaults to the highest already referenced.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Report what would change without writing. [default: False]

commands.name: ui
commands.description: Apply the GKit.UI.* breaking renames and report what needs a human.

options.name: --apply
options.description: Write the changes. Without it the command only reports. [default: False]

commands.name: release
commands.description: Publish and zip into build/ as <Project>.<height>-<branch>.zip.

arguments.name: PROJECTS
arguments.description: Projects to publish. Defaults to every web or exe project in the solution.
